documentations.title: Ubuntu Server Installation and Base Hardening Guide
documentations.content:
### Initial Provisioning

1. Boot the official Ubuntu 24.04 LTS minimal ISO image.
2. Partition disk with LVM over LUKS encryption for at-rest data protection.
3. Configure static IP addressing on interface eth0.
4. Create non-root administration account with sudo access.
5. Disable root password authentication via OpenSSH config.

documentations.title: Nginx Reverse Proxy & HTTP/3 Configuration Protocol
documentations.content:
### Ingress Architecture

- Deploy Nginx with HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 QUIC support.
- Configure upstream proxy pass to Next.js server on port 3000.
- Enable Brotli and Gzip compression for static assets.
- Enforce HSTS (Strict-Transport-Security) header with 2-year max-age.
- Set client body buffer limits to mitigate DDoS vectors.

documentations.title: Isolated Database VLAN 200 Security Segmentation
documentations.content:
### Network Segregation

Database servers reside exclusively inside isolated VLAN 200 without direct public internet exposure. Route ingress traffic exclusively through the internal load balancer and pgBouncer proxy.

Firewall rules restrict inbound port 5432 to whitelisted application node IP blocks.

documentations.title: Zero-Trust SSH Access & ED25519 Key Enactment
documentations.content:
### SSH Hardening Checklist

- PermitRootLogin no
- PasswordAuthentication no
- KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
- MaxAuthTries 3
- X11Forwarding no
- AllowAgentForwarding no
- Implement Fail2ban with 5-minute jail for failed attempts.

documentations.title: High-Availability PostgreSQL Failover & Backup Strategy
documentations.content:
### Automated Backup Runbook

1. Continuous WAL archiving to S3-compatible encrypted cold storage.
2. Nightly physical pg_basebackup with 30-day retention policy.
3. Weekly automated test restoration in staging environment.
4. Latency monitoring via Prometheus PostgreSQL exporter alerts.

documentations.title: BIND9 DNS Authoritative Zone Setup & DNSSEC Validation
documentations.content:
### DNS Zone Administration

Configure authoritative zone records for primary domain. Generate KSK (Key Signing Key) and ZSK (Zone Signing Key) using algorithm 13 (ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256). Submit DS records to parent registrar.

documentations.title: Troubleshooting High Memory Utilization on Node Runners
documentations.content:
### Diagnostic Workflow

1. Inspect system memory usage with `free -m` and `htop`.
2. Inspect top consumer processes with `ps aux --sort=-%mem | head -n 10`.
3. Generate heap snapshot using Node.js inspector protocol.
4. Check kernel dmesg logs for OOM killer trigger entries.
5. Adjust max-old-space-size parameters in systemd service definition.

documentations.title: Mail Server Postfix SPF, DKIM, and DMARC Policy Enactment
documentations.content:
### Email Deliverability & Anti-Spoofing

- Deploy OpenDKIM milter listening on localhost socket.
- Publish TXT record for SPF: `v=spf1 mx ip4:203.0.113.88 ~all`.
- Configure DMARC with rejection policy and aggregate forensic reporting email.
